title: Internal: handling procedure for the member's own confirmation of a Personal Training Packages cancellation
content:
## Applicable situation
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line. When a member wishes to cancel their personal-training package and take a refund of its unused sessions, the member themselves confirms the cancellation on their own authority.

## How it is invoked
This is a tool that belongs to the customer: it must first be unlocked and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves. Tool name: confirm_package_cancellation_cc17b6f3.

## Parameters
- pt_holding_id: the reference number of the personal-training package the member is cancelling, reachable by looking up the member's packages before this call.

## Return
On success, a confirmation naming the package's reference number, its new status, and its closed date; the status reading closed indicates the cancellation was recorded successfully, with the closed date set to the day the confirmation is given. If the named package does not exist, the tool returns an error stating that no personal-training package matches the given reference number, and no change is recorded.
